result.rationale: The diff shows `<%- end if %>` in app/views/embed/best.html.erb line 6. ERB compiles this to the Ruby fragment `end if`, which is a syntax error (an `end` cannot take an `if` modifier). This template compiles at render time, so any /embed/best request rendering it would raise a 500, and controller specs wouldn't catch it since views aren't rendered by default. The mechanism is verifiable from the diff.
